gen-fs-rajdhani-newsreader: Modern and clean, Rajdhani gives every curve the weight of a straight stem. Newsreader, a text serif, has modest stress in its curves and open jaws that carry paragraphs gently.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-archivo: Bold marker lines up top, a commanding body below. Red Hat Display does best at confident, constant-width lines with daylight in every curve, while Archivo does best at outward-opening curves and a commanding x-height.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-clash-grotesk: Contemporary and bold, Red Hat Display draws with a marker's constant width. Clash Grotesk, a sans-serif, drops stroke modulation entirely, so its clean, approachable lines sit beside the heading's visible daylight without competing.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-familjen-grote: Marker-steady lines up front, lively letters behind. Red Hat Display is best at lines that never thicken on downstrokes, while Familjen Grotesk is best at bowls left open on one side and lowercase that runs tall.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-merriweather-s: Merriweather Sans makes words look sturdy and large, with an e that opens clearly rightward. And paragraphs settle into a sturdy, unhurried rhythm under the marker-like lines of Red Hat Display.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-carme: Carme reads modern and open, its counters leading outward. Beneath the bold marker lines of Red Hat Display, whole paragraphs of its spaghetti-like line travel smoothly across the page.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-judson: Contemporary and bold, Red Hat Display draws one marker-like line with daylight in every curve. Judson, dignified and bookish, brings brush-lifted curve ends and fine hairlines, so extended reading feels settled and deliberate.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-snippet: Red Hat Display draws everything with a marker's constant width, leaving visible daylight inside every curve. But Snippet's wire-bent words and crescent-wrench c add a quirky, approachable streak beneath the bold heading.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-instrument-sans: Red Hat Display holds one marker-like width throughout, with visible daylight inside every curve. And Instrument Sans, with its pincer-open c and unvarying stroke, gives paragraphs a clean, modern, steady pace.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-montserrat: Red Hat Display draws a marker-steady line with daylight inside every curve. Montserrat brings the real surprise: generous white space, oversized counters and a wire-smooth glide that make the pairing feel inviting.
